## Load source files
```{r setup, include=FALSE,echo=F}
source("../R/Polysome_functions_RAUC.R")
library(limSolve)
library(data.table)
library("viridis")
library(GenomicFeatures)

```


###Density Independent Initiation Calculations

```{r DII, echo=F}
#Define parameter set. Since determinant method is being used I chose a very small mu. Prior exploration showed that a
#small mu behaves much like mu=0. The reason I am doing this is that calculating the adjugate matrix is slower than finding
#the full solution.
#mu values Hypothetical fast 1e-2  1% 9.994377e-04 5% 5.068461e-04 10% 3.500904e-04 25% 1.973310e-04 50% 1.081415e-04
#75% 5.500915e-05 90% 2.702400e-05 95%  1.763636e-05  99% 8.043137e-06
#Late March. Mike suggested keeping it to more round numbers ~99% 1500, ~50% 115, ~1% 11.5, sim 1.15
par.names <- c("kappa","mu","lambda","tau","delta","s2")
#arabidopsis
par.ranges <- list(c(seq(0.0001,0.5,0.0001)),c(0.01,1.004561*10^-3,5.068461*10^-4,3.500904*10^-4,1.973310*10^-4,1.004561*10^-4,5.500915*10^-5,2.702400*10^-5,1.763636*10^-5,7.701635*10^-6) ,c(1),c(1),c(100000),c(1))
imax.median <- 40
#yeast. Rounded minutes from Presnyak and then calculated quantiles and converted to seconds.
par.ranges <- list(c(seq(0.0001,0.5,0.0001)),c(0.01,0.0057762265, 0.0038508177, 0.0038508177, 0.0023104906, 0.0016503504, 0.0008251752, 0.0004443251, 0.0003300701, 0.0002221626) ,c(1),c(1),c(100000),c(1))
plot1.params <- CreateParMatrix(parameter.range = par.ranges,fixed = F,par.names = par.names)
imax.median <- 39
plot1.params <- as.data.table(plot1.params)
plot1.params[,"index":=1:nrow(plot1.params)]
#calculate unmarked class
Unmarked_imax_median_plot1 <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcUnmarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("tau")))

#Calculate summary statistics
U_pct_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_percent(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1)
U_mean_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_mean(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1)
U_sd_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_sd(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1)
U_mode_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_mode(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1)

#plot curves for figure 1 example
peaks_mean <- round(U_mean_imax_median_plot1[plot1.params[mu==par.ranges[[2]][10],index]])
peaks_mode <- U_mode_imax_median_plot1[plot1.params[mu==par.ranges[[2]][10],index]]
#peaks_mean_index <- unlist(lapply(c(0,5,10,15,25,30), function(i) which(peaks_mean==i)[1]))
peaks_mean_index <- unlist(lapply(c(2,20,imax.median-1), function(i) which(peaks_mean==i)[1]))
#peaks_mode_index <- unlist(lapply(c(0,5,10,15,25,30), function(i) which(peaks_mode==i)[1]))
#peaks_mean_index[1] <- 10
Initiation_rates <- unlist(plot1.params[peaks_mean_index,1])
names(Initiation_rates) <- c("Low","Mid","High")

Marked_imax_median_plot1 <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcMarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("tau")))

M_pct_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_percent(Marked_imax_median_plot1)
M_mean_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_mean(Marked_imax_median_plot1)
M_sd_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_sd(Marked_imax_median_plot1)
M_mode_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_mode(Marked_imax_median_plot1)


Full_imax_median_plot1 <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) Classes(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("tau")))

F_pct_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_percent(Full_imax_median_plot1)
F_mean_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_mean(Full_imax_median_plot1)
F_sd_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_sd(Full_imax_median_plot1)
F_mode_imax_median_plot1 <- Ribo_mode(Full_imax_median_plot1)



```

###Density Independent Initiation Calculations w/ imax range

```{r DII imax, echo=F}
#imax will be 8,15,41,87,164 The 1%, 10%, 50%, 90%, and 99% quantiles of arabidopsis
#Arabidopsis
imax.range <- c(8,15,41,87,164)
#yeast
imax.range <- c(4,12,39,98,194)
imax.percentiles <- c("1%","10%","50%","90%","99%")
names(imax.range) <- imax.percentiles
Unmarked_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(imax.range,function(j) apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcUnmarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = j,rescale = F,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("tau"))))
names(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1) <- imax.percentiles

#Calculate summary statistics
U_pct_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_percent)
U_mean_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_mean)
U_mode_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_mode)
U_sd_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_sd)

U_mean_imax_range_plot1[[3]][plot1.params[(kappa==Initiation_rates[1])&(mu==par.ranges[[2]][10]),index]]

#profile plots imax range
peak_positions <- c(0.01,0.10,0.5,0.90,0.99)

peaks_mean_imax_range <- lapply(1:length(imax.range),function(i) round(U_mean_imax_range_plot1[[i]][plot1.params[mu==par.ranges[[2]][10],index]]/imax.range[i],2))
peaks_mean_index_imax_range <- lapply(1:length(imax.range), function(i) unlist(lapply(peak_positions,function(j) which(peaks_mean_imax_range[[i]]==j)[1])))

Marked_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(imax.range,function(j) apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcMarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = j,rescale = F,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("tau"))))
names(Marked_imax_range_plot1) <- imax.percentiles

#Calculate summary statistics
M_pct_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Marked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_percent)
M_mean_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Marked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_mean)
M_mode_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Marked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_mode)
M_sd_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Marked_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_sd)


Full_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(imax.range,function(j) apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) Classes(parameters = i,imax = j,rescale = F,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("tau"))))

F_pct_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Full_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_percent)
F_mean_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Full_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_mean)
F_mode_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Full_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_mode)
F_sd_imax_range_plot1 <- lapply(Full_imax_range_plot1,Ribo_sd)

```


###Density Dependent Initiation Calculations

```{r DDI, echo=F}
#Define parameter set. Since determinant method is being used I chose a very small mu. Prior exploration showed that a
#small mu behaves much like mu=0. The reason I am doing this is that calculating the adjugate matrix is slower than finding
#the full solution.
#mu values Hypothetical fast 1e-2  1% 9.994377e-04 5% 5.068461e-04 10% 3.500904e-04 25% 1.973310e-04 50% 1.081415e-04
#75% 5.500915e-05 90% 2.702400e-05 95%  1.763636e-05  99% 8.043137e-06
par.names <- c("kappa","mu","lambda","tau","delta","s2")
#arabidopsis
par.ranges <- list(c(seq(0.0001,0.5,0.0001)),c(0.01,1.004561*10^-3,5.068461*10^-4,3.500904*10^-4,1.973310*10^-4,1.004561*10^-4,5.500915*10^-5,2.702400*10^-5,1.763636*10^-5,7.701635*10^-6) ,c(1),c(1),c(100000),c(1))
imax.median <- 40
plot1.params <- CreateParMatrix(parameter.range = par.ranges,fixed = F,par.names = par.names)
plot1.params <- as.data.table(plot1.params)
plot1.params[,"index":=1:nrow(plot1.params)]
#calculate unmarked class
AT_Unmarked_imax_median_plot1_int <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcUnmarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))
AT_Marked_imax_median_plot1_int <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcMarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))
AT_Full_imax_median_plot1_int <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) Classes(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))
AT_F_mean_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mean(Full_imax_median_plot1_int)

AT_F_pct_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_percent(AT_Full_imax_median_plot1_int)
AT_F_mean_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mean(AT_Full_imax_median_plot1_int)
AT_F_sd_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_sd(AT_Full_imax_median_plot1_int)
AT_F_mode_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mode(AT_Full_imax_median_plot1_int)


#yeast. Rounded minutes from Presnyak and then calculated quantiles and converted to seconds.
par.ranges <- list(c(seq(0.0001,0.5,0.0001)),c(0.01,0.0057762265, 0.0038508177, 0.0038508177, 0.0023104906, 0.0016503504, 0.0008251752, 0.0004443251, 0.0003300701, 0.0002221626) ,c(1),c(1),c(100000),c(1))
plot1.params <- CreateParMatrix(parameter.range = par.ranges,fixed = F,par.names = par.names)
imax.median <- 39
plot1.params <- as.data.table(plot1.params)
plot1.params[,"index":=1:nrow(plot1.params)]
# Rows of plot1.params holding the k-th entry of the mu vector par.ranges[[2]]
# (expand.grid puts kappa fastest, so each mu is one contiguous block). Selected
# by position, not by value, because yeast entries 3 and 4 are identical. The
# stopifnot guards against the grid layout changing under hard-coded positions.
mu_block_rows <- function(k) {
  n <- length(par.ranges[[1]])
  rows <- ((k - 1) * n + 1):(k * n)
  stopifnot(all(plot1.params[rows, mu] == par.ranges[[2]][k]))
  rows
}
#calculate unmarked class
Unmarked_imax_median_plot1_int <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcUnmarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))



#Calculate summary statistics
U_pct_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_percent(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1_int)
U_mean_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mean(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1_int)
U_sd_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_sd(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1_int)
U_mode_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mode(Unmarked_imax_median_plot1_int)

Marked_imax_median_plot1_int <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) CalcMarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))

M_pct_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_percent(Marked_imax_median_plot1_int)
M_mean_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mean(Marked_imax_median_plot1_int)
M_sd_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_sd(Marked_imax_median_plot1_int)
M_mode_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mode(Marked_imax_median_plot1_int)


Full_imax_median_plot1_int <- apply(plot1.params,1,function(i) Classes(parameters = i,imax = imax.median,rescale = T,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))

F_pct_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_percent(Full_imax_median_plot1_int)
F_mean_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mean(Full_imax_median_plot1_int)
F_sd_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_sd(Full_imax_median_plot1_int)
F_mode_imax_median_plot1_int <- Ribo_mode(Full_imax_median_plot1_int)


```

### Result 1


```{r Figure1 1, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
old.dir <- getwd()
Check_dir("../../Results/",add=T)
setwd(paste(old.dir,"../../Results/",gsub(Sys.Date(),pattern = "-",replacement = ""),sep="/"))


png(paste(Sys.Date(),"_Figure1_DIIvsDDI_medianlength_low_marking.png",sep=""),width = 8,height = 6,units = "in",res=300)
Initiation_rates <- c(0.001,0.01,0.1)
layout(matrix(c(1,2,3,4,4,4,5,5,5,6,7,8,9,9,9),nrow = 3,ncol=5),widths = c(2,2,1,2,2),heights = c(1,1,1))

for(i in 3:1){
  if(i==1){
    par(mar=c(4.1,5.1,1.1,0.1))
  }else if(i==3){
    par(mar=c(1.1,5.1,1.1,0.1))
  }else{
    par(mar=c(1.1,5.1,1.1,0.1))
  }
  plot(0:39,F_pct_imax_median_plot1[,plot1.params[mu==par.ranges[[2]][10],][kappa==Initiation_rates[i],index]],pch=20,xlab="",ylab="",ylim=c(0,0.7),axes=F)
  lines(0:39,F_pct_imax_median_plot1[,plot1.params[mu==par.ranges[[2]][10],][kappa==Initiation_rates[i],index]],pch=20)
  axis(1,at = seq(0,39,10),labels = seq(0,39,10),las=2)
  axis(2,at = seq(0,0.7,0.1),labels = seq(0,0.7,0.1),las=2)
  box()
  if(i == 1) {
    mtext(1,text = "Polysomal Class",line=2.5,cex=1,xpd=F)
    text(x=10,y=0.6,"low",font=2,cex=1.2)
  } else if(i == 2){
    mtext(2,text = "Ribosomal Location Probability",line=2.5,cex=1,xpd=F)
    text(x=10,y=0.6,"mid",font=2,cex=1.2)
  } else {
    text(x=10,y=0.6,"high",font=2,cex=1.2)
  }

}
```

```{r Duc and Song model results, echo=F}
#Yeast work from ENSEMBL, Presnyak, Weinberg and Duc
#Weinberg RPKM
Weinberg_mRNA_RPKM <- fread("../../Data/GSE75897_RiboZero_RPKMs.txt",sep="\t",stringsAsFactors = F,header = F)
setkey(Weinberg_mRNA_RPKM,"V1")

Weinberg_RPF_RPKM <- fread("../../Data/GSE75897_RPF_RPKMs.txt",sep="\t",stringsAsFactors = F,header = F)
setkey(Weinberg_RPF_RPKM,"V1")


#Sc length
library(Biostrings)

sc.proteins <- Biostrings::readAAStringSet("../../Data/yeast_proteins.FASTA")


#Half lives from Presnyak_2015
Presnyak_2015 <- fread("../../Data/SC_halflives_Presnyak_2015.txt")

#Read in intiation rates from Duc 2018
Duc_Initiation <- fread("../../Data/Duc2018/Initiation_rates_DUC.txt", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F,header=T)

#Read in elongation rates from Duc 2018
Duc_Elongation <- fread("../../Data/Duc2018/Elongation_rates_DUC.txt", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F,header=F)

#View(Duc_Elongation)

Duc_Genes <- Duc_Elongation[seq(1,nrow(Duc_Elongation),7),1]
Duc_Sequence <- Duc_Elongation[seq(2,nrow(Duc_Elongation),7),]
Duc_Experimental <- Duc_Elongation[seq(3,nrow(Duc_Elongation),7),]
Duc_Infered <- Duc_Elongation[seq(4,nrow(Duc_Elongation),7),]
Duc_Sequence_lengths <- unlist(apply(Duc_Sequence,1,function(i) grep(x = unlist(i),pattern = "TGA|TAG|TAA")))

Arith_mean_inferred <- apply(Duc_Infered,1,function(i) mean(as.numeric(unlist(i)),na.rm=T))
names(Arith_mean_inferred) <- unlist(Duc_Genes)

harmonic_inferred <- apply(Duc_Infered,1,function(i) mean(as.numeric(unlist(i)),na.rm=T))
names(Arith_mean_inferred) <- unlist(Duc_Genes)

min_elongation_inferred <- apply(Duc_Infered,1,function(i) mean(as.numeric(unlist(i)),na.rm=T))
names(Arith_mean_inferred) <- unlist(Duc_Genes)


#Arith_mean_inferred
Duc.DT <- cbind(Duc_Initiation[,c(1,3)],Arith_mean_inferred)
setkeyv(Duc.DT,"ORF")

Presnyak_2015_Duc <- Presnyak_2015[which(unlist(Presnyak_2015[,c(1)])%in%unlist(Duc.DT[,1])),]
marking_rate_Presnyak <- log(2)/(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,4]*60)
marking_rate_Presnyak[,"GENE":=unlist(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,1])]

sc.names <- unlist(lapply(names(sc.proteins),function(i) strsplit(x=i,split="\\|")[[1]][1]))

sc.proteins_Duc <- width(sc.proteins)[which(sc.names%in%unlist(Duc.DT[unlist(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,1]),1]))]
names(sc.proteins_Duc) <- sc.names[which(sc.names%in%unlist(Duc.DT[unlist(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,1]),1]))]


Weinberg_mRNA_RPKM_Duc <- Weinberg_mRNA_RPKM[unlist(Duc.DT[unlist(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,1]),1]),]

Weinberg_RPF_RPKM_Duc <- Weinberg_RPF_RPKM[unlist(Duc.DT[unlist(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,1]),1]),]

TE <- Weinberg_RPF_RPKM_Duc
TE[,"TE":=Weinberg_RPF_RPKM_Duc[,2]/Weinberg_mRNA_RPKM_Duc[,2]] 
setkeyv(TE,"V1")

imax_duc <- floor(sc.proteins_Duc/9)

plot1.params.Duc <- plot1.params[1:704,]
plot1.params.Duc[,1] <- Duc.DT[unlist(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,1]),2]
plot1.params.Duc[,4] <- Duc.DT[unlist(Presnyak_2015_Duc[,1]),3]
plot1.params.Duc[,2] <- marking_rate_Presnyak[,1]
plot1.params.Duc[,"Genes":=marking_rate_Presnyak[,2]]
setkey(plot1.params.Duc,"Genes")
plot1.params.Duc[names(imax_duc),"imax":=imax_duc]
plot1.params.Duc[,"RPKM":=Weinberg_mRNA_RPKM_Duc[,2]]
TE <- TE[names(imax_duc),][which(is.na(plot1.params.Duc[,imax])==F),]
plot1.params.Duc <- plot1.params.Duc[which(is.na(imax)==F),]
plot1.params.Duc[,-8]

Unmarked_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int <- apply(plot1.params.Duc[,-8],1,function(i) CalcUnmarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = as.numeric(unlist(i[8])),rescale = F,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))

#Calculate summary statistics
U_pct_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int,Ribo_percent)
U_mean_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int,Ribo_mean)
U_mode_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int,Ribo_mode)
U_sd_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int <- lapply(Unmarked_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int,Ribo_sd)

Marked_imax_range_plot1_Duc_int <- apply(plot1.params.Duc[,-8],1,function(i) CalcMarkedClass(parameters = i,imax = as.numeric(unlist(i[8])),rescale = F,rescale.val = "tau",par.names = par.names,interference = T,which.interfere = c("kappa","tau")))

#Calculate summary statistics
```
